title: Content locator
description: Where a content kind's content lives (ADR 0128, ADR 0142): a URL, naming an external resource or an asset in the aggregate's asset store as /assets/<hash>. A Resource owns no file beside its Resource file and no kind has a path for bytes: every file a Resource uses is an asset (ADR 0142). Each kind narrows which URLs it accepts. Kind schemas apply unevaluatedProperties, so this schema does not close the object.
